# Air Filtration Systems

> > Advanced multi-stage HEPA and activated carbon air purification systems for dust, VOCs, odors, and chemical fumes across residential, commercial, medical, and industrial applications.

Air Filtration Systems specializes in comprehensive air purification solutions using HEPA filtration, activated carbon, and multi-stage technology. The site serves diverse markets including healthcare facilities, nail salons, data centers, 3D printing operations, and residential spaces, with flagship product lines including BP Series, BH Series, AF Series (Quatro), and specialized fume extractors.

## Key Topics

- HEPA Filtration
- VOC Removal
- Multi-Stage Filtration
- Odor Control
- Chemical Fume Removal
- BP Series Purifiers
- BH400/AF400 Models
- Indoor Air Quality
- Activated Carbon Filters
- Infection Control
- Dust Particle Control
- Formaldehyde Removal
- Commercial Air Filtration
- Medical-Grade Purification
- Pressure Room Systems

- [Multi-Purpose Air Purifiers – Advanced Filtration for Dust & Fumes](https://air-filtration-systems.com): Homepage showcasing multi-stage HEPA filtration for dust, VOCs, and industrial air quality

- [BH400 / AF400 Air Filtration for Home & Small Workspaces](https://air-filtration-systems.com/bh400-air-purifier.html): BH400/AF400 compact purifier with 6 ACH filtration for homes and small commercial spaces
- [HEPA Air Purifier – Odor, Gas & Microorganism Filtration Solution](https://air-filtration-systems.com/HEPA-Air-Purifiers.html): HEPA-based purifiers removing gases, odors, bacteria, viruses, and fungal spores
- [Multi-Stage Air Purifiers – HEPA & Chemical Filters for Dust & Fumes](https://air-filtration-systems.com/Multi-Stage-Filtration.html): Advanced multi-stage HEPA and activated carbon filtration for dust, odors, gases, fumes
